title: I5: ice maker tooth (notch 6.6, W7 slot, 3 mm keel, arm +0.5)
settings: Pick any PETG preset, e.g. Generic PETG
note: Prints FLAT, no supports, don't auto-orient. Before installing, cut out the thin skin across the bottom of the slot (narrow AND the wider part near the wall), away from the ice maker. Install: hook the bottom under the wall first, then rock the tooth down.
